text:
کچا گنڈھ نہ پھوئیے؛ پک آپے پھسے۔
بھائیاں نال نہ چھیڑیے؛ کر کھاجن حصے۔
دشمن ہووے سو کوہ تے، کول منجی دے دسے۔
romanized:
Kachchā gannh na phōié; pakk āpé phissé.
Bhāiā̃ nāl na chhéṛié; kar khājan hissé.
Dushman hōvé sau koh té, kōl manjjī dé dissé.
literal_en:
One should not squeeze a raw boil; it will discharge of itself when mature.
One should not quarrel with one's brothers; shares divided off will be consumed.
Though one's enemy be a hundred miles off, one should act as if he were visible beside one's bed.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
